(1) The buffer pair: the word at +0x0 is loaded as the size (0x1538ecb / 0x474dcdb); if it is non-zero the pointer at +0x8 (0x1538ed3 / 0x474dce3) is freed through the dealloc slot 0x64df4a0 (RELATIVE target 0x635de30) with that size and align 0.  (2) The tagged pair: data word at +0x30 and descriptor word at +0x38 are loaded (0x1538edf / 0x1538ee3); descriptor word 0 is called on the data when non-null (0x1538ef3), then the data is freed through the dealloc slot with the size class computed from descriptor words +0x8 (size) and +0x10 (align) by the tzcnt/cmova idiom (0x1538f04), gated on the size word.  This is the final disposition of the taken entries' +0x8/+0x10 words that #2506 staged into the records and #2559 followed to these drops.  (3) The sub-vector headed at +0x18: a drain callee is called on element+0x18, then the header word at +0x18 is loaded and, if non-zero, the buffer at +0x20 is freed through the dealloc slot at word * 0x10 bytes (shl 4 at 0x1538f39) as a tail jump.  The record words at +0x10 and +0x28 are never loaded anywhere in either body (element field census over both dumps: the +0x0 word is loaded once at entry through rdi, and the rbx displacements are exactly +0x8, +0x18, +0x20, +0x30, +0x38).

The first pad (0x1538f5c / 0x474dd6c) saves the exception, re-runs the tagged pair's descriptor free with the same tzcnt class idiom, drains the sub-vector through the alternate unwind drain callee (0x1539990 / 0x474e270, called on element+0x18), and falls into the resume.
